termination_notice_period.value: Written notice of termination at least 30 days before the effective date (10 days for failure to pay the Initial Franchise Fee or an installment, or failure to timely enter information into the agency management system), with a cure period; some defaults terminate automatically without notice, and others immediately upon written notice without any opportunity to cure. The Minnesota amendments require 90 days' notice of termination (with 60 days to cure) and 180 days' notice of non-renewal for Minnesota-governed franchisees.
evidence: we may terminate this Agreement by giving you written notice of termination (in the manner provided under Section 24 below) stating the nature of the default at least thirty (30) days before the effective date of termination

(or ten (10) days before the effective date of termination for (i) any failure to pay the Initial Franchise Fee or an installment thereof, or (ii) any failure to timely enter information into the agency management system as required by the Manual)
all rights granted in this Agreement will automatically terminate without notice to you

we will have the right to terminate this Agreement and all rights granted under this Agreement, without affording you any opportunity to cure the default, effective immediately upon the delivery of our written notice to you

Stat. § 80C.14, Subds. 3, 4, and 5 which require, except in certain specified cases, that a franchisee be given 90 days' notice of termination (with 60 days to cure) and 180 days' notice of non-renewal of the Franchise Agreement

payment_terms.value: Initial Franchise Fee payable in full on signing, or partly on signing with the balance plus interest under a 60-month Promissory Note (amount left blank in the Declarations Page). Royalty Fee is the greater of 20% of Gross Revenues on initial-term policies or a Minimum Royalty of $600 per month for months 6-18 and $1,000 per month thereafter, plus 50% of Gross Revenues on renewal and re-write policies. Marketing Contribution up to 2% of Gross Revenues each Month. Franchisor receives Commissions, Premiums and fees, remits Net Revenues monthly on the 25th, direct receipts must be forwarded within 24 hours, and payments are made by electronic funds transfer/ACH, with 18% annual interest on overdue amounts.

supplementary.notes: Franchise agreement form (Exhibit 10.6) with blank franchisee identity and blank fee/date fields, followed by state-specific FDD addenda and amendments. No execution is signed: state-amendment blocks preprint "Name: P. Ryan Langston / Title: Vice President and General Counsel" under By:, but no /s/ or filled signature appears. The primary dispute forum is Section 27.2 (state/judicial district of the franchisor principal place of business); state addenda mention arbitration-site rules for Washington and North Dakota and forum restrictions for Rhode Island and New York, recorded here rather than in the field. The base renewal clause (at least six months, not more than nine, before term end) is an election-to-renew deadline, not a termination notice; the Minnesota amendment adds the 180-day non-renewal notice captured in termination_notice_period. Territory: Section 1.3 is headed "No Protected Territory" and disclaims any protected area.
